milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Produce current release evidence and establish whether version 1.1.1 can pass trusted internal production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Merged the reviewed release controls through protected PR #6; verified deterministic candidate output, merge-SHA matrix, Gitleaks, CodeQL, and hosted safeguards; retained blockers for trusted identities and internal artifact operations.

decisions.rationale: Trusted signature, distinct independent review, internal artifact health/revocation, and production verification do not pass.

decisions.decision: Accept merge-SHA CI as current evidence.
decisions.rationale: Run 33980792156 proves nine OS/Node jobs, three Gitleaks jobs, and aggregate evidence for 5190959; CodeQL run 33980792246 also passes.

decisions.decision: Reduce ARCF-0205 and SECF-0205 to medium.
decisions.rationale: Automated hosted safeguards are enabled; only independent human source review awaits a second collaborator.
No controlled signer, distinct reviewer, or restricted artifact destination is available.

validation.evidence: 151 checksum-covered files, CycloneDX SBOM, in-toto provenance, and deterministic fdf82200 digest verify.
Security Validation run 33980792156 and CodeQL run 33980792246 pass for 5190959 with zero open alerts.
Required checks, admin enforcement, linear history, force-push/deletion protection, secret/dependency/vulnerability controls, restricted Actions, and CodeQL upload are enabled.
Clarification, architecture, security, deployment, readiness, and CI evidence reports validate.
Operational artifact health/revocation, trusted signature, distinct independent review, and production verification remain blocked.
Blocked schema-v3 execution validates against immutable PSO-124 snapshot 040dad9a.

worktree.attribution: This handoff attributes only P4 evidence and continuity reports; source and unrelated existing changes remain untouched.

blockers: Trusted signature and distinct independent review are absent.
No restricted internal artifact destination, installation-health signal, or tested revocation operation exists.
Required human source review awaits a second qualified collaborator.
pendingApprovals: Trusted signing by a controlled identity.
Independent review by a distinct qualified reviewer.
Selection and test of a restricted internal artifact destination.
limitations: No signing, release, publication, deployment, or Azure mutation occurred.
Remote-only refs and unreachable objects were not scanned.

nextAction.action: Resume P4 after designating a controlled signer, distinct qualified reviewer, second source reviewer, and restricted internal artifact destination for health and revocation testing.
prerequisites: Do not self-sign or self-approve independent review.
Keep release, publication, deployment, and Azure mutation prohibited until separately approved.
